posts.name: Dograh
posts.tagline: The open source VAPI alternative
posts.description: Closed voice platforms make you rent your own agents. Dograh is completely open source- nothing is gated. Visual flow builder, add your model key across 30+ integrations or use local models, telephony, human transfer, and advanced QA & monitoring - all free to self-host in one command. Also connect your claude code with MCP to build voice agents for a use case or call recordings.

posts.name: Grok Bot
posts.tagline: AI teammates that you can give real work to
posts.description: Introducing Grok Bot: AI teammates you can give real work to. Bots sign into your tools, use them like you do, and come back with finished work. Message them like a teammate. They keep context, multitask, and learn your working style on their own cloud computer. Ask Bots to run outbound overnight, code expenses from Gmail, schedule a recruiting onsite, rebalance paid ads, or ship a bug pack. They only come back when something needs your approval.

posts.name: Lettertrace
posts.tagline: Track your AI visibility for free (using your own API keys!)
posts.description: Lettertrace measures how often Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini mention your company. But there's a catch: it's free, developer-first, bring-your-own-key, and open source.

posts.name: Assembly Studio
posts.tagline: AI app builder that grows your revenue
posts.description: Assembly Studio is the AI app builder made for professional service firms. Describe what you want: onboarding agents, analytics dashboards, community hubs, and get production-grade apps in minutes. 20+ templates to remix. Connects to any 3rd-party tool. Clone any overpriced app charging you per seat. Free forever plan. Stop paying for someone else's software. Build the firm only you can build.

posts.name: Unsloth Desktop
posts.tagline: Run and train AI models locally on your desktop
posts.description: Unsloth Desktop is an open-source app to run and train AI models locally. Run LLMs, image/video diffusion, and audio. Connect agents like Claude Code or Codex to your local GPU with one command, and fine-tune models with no-code workflows.

posts.name: BearDrive
posts.tagline: The open-source shared folder for your team's AI agents
posts.description: Your AI agents create real files locally: reports, decks, CSVs, research. BearDrive syncs the folder they already work in, so every file is born shared: versioned, attributed down to the agent session, with links only your team can open. Unlike Notion or Drive, nobody moves anything; a teammate's agent reads your agent's work at a real local path seconds later. Works with Claude Code, Cowork, Codex, Gemini CLI, any local tool. Open source and self-hostable. Managed service free during beta.

posts.name: LaraCopilot
posts.tagline: Agentic AI Engineer that builds real apps
posts.description: LaraCopilot is an agentic AI engineer that builds real, production-ready apps. Describe your idea in your own language and it builds the whole thing: UI, backend, database, auth, and APIs, wired together and ready to deploy. One-click deploy to the cloud or your own server, GitHub export, instant rollback. No lock-in. The code is yours.

posts.name: Swipe
posts.tagline: Swipe right on your next customer
posts.description: Type who you sell to. Swipe deals a ranked deck of real companies. Keep the ones worth an email, skip the rest, export to CSV. No signup, no credits, no scraped inboxes.

posts.name: Click
posts.tagline: Live research context for ChatGPT and Claude
posts.description: Click is an MCP that provides extensive research connectors to give external context that the built-in web search misses. It provides live context from professional & social platforms, marketplaces, financials, and more. A simple 1-min installation of the MCP in ChatGPT or Claude enables you to do more inside chat.

posts.name: RightCard
posts.tagline: The honest credit card picker — no bank login
posts.description: RightCard tells you which of your cards to use at any store and auto-adds the bank offers you'd forget to activate (Amex, Chase, Citi, Wells Fargo). It keeps rotating 5% categories straight so you don't have to remember them, and warns you before card credits and annual fees renew. No bank login, no account, no tracking — the Safari extension reads the offers page you're already signed into, and recommendations are computed on your phone, even offline. Honest numbers only. Free, no ads.

posts.name: Media Sharing
posts.tagline: Let AI agents put screenshots and videos on pull requests
posts.description: GitHub has no API for attaching images to pull requests, so agents and CI ship blind. Argos Media Sharing fixes it: one command turns a screenshot or recording into a stable share link with ready-to-paste Markdown, and posts it on the PR automatically.

posts.name: CodeBurn
posts.tagline: See where your AI coding spend actually goes
posts.description: CodeBurn is a free, open-source tracker for AI coding costs. It reads the session files your tools already write - Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, 40 in all, and shows every token and dollar by the task, model, project, and pull request that used it. The Optimize tab finds waste like cache bloat or retry tax, applies the fix, and tracks what it actually saved. Everything runs on your machine: no account, no uploads. MIT-licensed and genuinely free, used by 150k+ developers across the world.

posts.name: tash
posts.tagline: The investment platform for trading cards
posts.description: tash gives investors access to professionally curated portfolios of high-end graded trading cards. tash manages sourcing, verification, vaulting, reporting, and the eventual sale of the underlying assets.

posts.name: Chat Agent by Trigger.dev
posts.tagline: AI chat that keeps running after you close the tab
posts.description: Chat agent is a way to build durable AI chat experiences that run on a machine with no timeouts and keep streaming through refreshes and crashes. The machine sleeps when nobody's typing and wakes where it left off, without you managing any state. Keep the AI SDK you already use: streamText on the server, useChat on the client. chat.agent slots in underneath as a transport and the API route between them goes away. Every turn is traced: prompts, tool calls, latency and cost.

posts.name: Ballet
posts.tagline: Agentic workflows that deliver the same outcome every time
posts.description: Ballet lets operations teams automate their hardest business problems in minutes. Describe a workflow in plain English. Ballet writes (in code) + runs it, with full audit log, one-click rollback, simulation mode, and you choose how much it can do.

posts.name: Sidekick™
posts.tagline: The agentic interface
posts.description: The next big interface for your Mac and the agentic layer for your entire organisation.

posts.name: Cohesor
posts.tagline: A neutral control plane for enterprise AI agents
posts.description: Cohesor is the neutral control plane for AI agents. It sits between your agents - Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, agentic workflow and every LLM model: compressing ~50% of tokens, routing each request to the right-sized model, and governing spend per user for your team. One endpoint, zero code changes, 60–90% lower agent bills. Agent spend is exploding with almost no tooling to understand or control it. The neutral, cost-first control layer is the empty quadrant. Cohesor is built for exactly that.

posts.name: Linforge
posts.tagline: Turn Anki flashcards into real English conversations
posts.description: Practice English speaking like you're chatting with a real person. Linforge gives instant phoneme-level pronunciation and grammar correction on every sentence, syncs with your Anki decks, and tracks your progress over time.

posts.name: Nearfield
posts.tagline: Turn two or more Studio Displays into stereo speakers
posts.description: Nearfield is a native, open-source Mac app that combines the speakers in two Apple Studio Displays into one volume-controllable stereo output. Swap left and right, adjust balance, and use app and window based audio routing. Requires Apple silicon, two Studio Displays, and macOS 14+.

posts.name: Statewave
posts.tagline: Open-source memory runtime for production AI agents.
posts.description: Open-source memory runtime for AI agents. Durable, structured context with provenance, self-hosted on Postgres.

posts.name: BikeQuest
posts.tagline: MORE FUN 🎉 EVERY RIDE 🚲
posts.description: Pick real-world cycling quests, upload photo proof, and collect BikeQuest badges. No pressure. No leaderboard.

posts.name: BeeL
posts.tagline: Invoicing API
posts.description: In Spain, every invoice now has to be tamper-proof and reported to the tax agency. That's Verifactu, and building it yourself eats a quarter of engineering time. BeeL is one API that just does it. Point us at your payments and each charge becomes a legal invoice, filed with the tax agency and emailed to your customer. One click on Stripe, no code — or wire the API into your product. REST, SDKs, and a CLI so Claude Code or any AI agent can invoice. Free sandbox, no limits.

posts.name: Cleanup
posts.tagline: Erase unwanted objects from photos in seconds
posts.description: cleanup.photo is the fastest way to remove unwanted objects, people, text, logos, and distractions from your photos. Upload an image, brush over what you want gone, and cleanup.photo intelligently rebuilds the area around it — no complicated editing tools or design skills required. Simple enough for anyone. Fast enough to use every day. Core positioning The easiest way to make unwanted things disappear from your photos.

posts.name: Defellix
posts.tagline: Never lose a payment to a ghosting client again
posts.description: Defellix helps freelancers in India create contracts that actually hold up if a client stops paying. No WhatsApp promises. Contracts are timestamped, blockchain-anchored, and court-admissible under Section 65B, created in about 2 minutes, client signs with just an OTP. Also included: auto-generated demand notices, milestone tracking, and MSME guidance for faster recovery. Early-stage team, building in the open. Would love your feedback.

posts.name: Guardrail by NeatProxy
posts.tagline: Full visibility into your AI spend, before it goes rogue
posts.description: We burned real money running AI agents and didn't know why until it was too late. That's the whole reason Guardrail exists. It's a local proxy for Claude Code and Codex that shows you where every dollar goes, system prompt, tools, that MCP server you forgot about, before you spend it. When you're about to blow a budget, Guardrail blocks the request. Not after. Before. Built for developers who'd rather see the bill coming than explain it later.

posts.name: Linkdify
posts.tagline: Your entire LinkedIn GTM team, run by AI
posts.description: Linkdify is your AI LinkedIn GTM team. Claim a real, warmed LinkedIn account we provision, so you never risk your own, then let AI agents find leads with buying signals, write outreach that sounds human, and send DMs, connection requests, and voice notes across automated campaigns. Fully MCP-native, so you can run your whole pipeline right from Claude. Turn LinkedIn into a steady stream of booked meetings, on autopilot.

posts.name: UGC Agent
posts.tagline: The world's best AI agent for finding UGC creators
posts.description: Sourcing UGC creators is slow, and their emails are impossible to find. UGC Agent does both. Describe who you need in plain English; it finds Instagram + TikTok creators, scores them against your ICP, and hands back export-ready leads, with verified emails.

posts.name: Yoomru
posts.tagline: Shopify Social Media Auto-post App
posts.description: Yoomru is a Shopify social media auto-poster that publishes your products across 11 social networks, including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, X, YouTube, LinkedIn, Threads, Google Business Profile, Telegram, and Discord, right from your Shopify admin. Branded product videos render from your real catalog, planners auto-match products on a schedule, and review cards turn customer reviews into social posts. The free plan actually publishes: 30 posts per month, no credit card required.

posts.name: Teyla
posts.tagline: Intelligent planner for every role in your life
posts.description: Teyla is a task and planning app built to give every role the attention it deserves. Add tasks by typing or speaking, and Teyla’s AI understands what needs doing, when it matters and which part of your life it belongs to. It organises everything around the roles you play, builds a realistic plan around your calendars, and reminds you at the right time and place. So you can focus on the role you’re in, knowing Teyla is keeping track of the rest.

posts.name: Upranke
posts.tagline: Show up in every AI answer that matters to your business
posts.description: Track your brand's visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity & Bing AI. Get AI visibility audits, citation tracking, and competitor insights.

posts.name: My Existence
posts.tagline: Your life is about 4,000 weeks. Here you can fill them.
posts.description: A quiet place to keep your life. Every entry is a spatial canvas — drag cards or images anywhere on the grid, no linear document. Navigate everything in a life-in-weeks view, where each week you've lived is one cell. Share your profile with friends, or keep it private. Look back at your own milestones when you need a push. And also it's completely free.

posts.name: designdex.org
posts.tagline: Turn research into evidence based design decisions
posts.description: DesignDex is a design research platform built for students, designers, and innovators. Discover credible research papers, academic studies, and evidence across product design, engineering, psychology, ergonomics, sustainability, materials, technology, and more. Search or explore multidisciplinary research, find unexpected insights, and build better design projects backed by real evidence, not AI-generated citations.

posts.name: Fovea
posts.tagline: Video in, your JSON out — validated against your schema
posts.description: Fovea turns a video into JSON that matches a schema you supply. Send a video and a JSON Schema — or a rough sketch of one — to one endpoint, or add the MCP server to Claude Code or Codex in a single line. Every response is validated against your schema before it is returned; a malformed shape is retried internally, never handed back half-right. Any field can carry a timestamp. Videos are deleted once the job finishes. 30 free minutes, no card.

posts.name: MOTA
posts.tagline: AI agents that follow your rules, not their imagination.
posts.description: MOTA is a governed execution runtime for high-consequence workflows. Instead of letting LLMs improvise, MOTA separates AI planning from deterministic execution. It translates user intent into a strict execution graph to enforce business policies, retrieve live data, and route tasks conditionally. With human-in-the-loop approval gates, durable execution states, and transparent audit records, MOTA guarantees that sensitive customer support actions are safe, predictable, and fully verifiable.

posts.name: Task Gremlin
posts.tagline: Not one more chatbot. A bench of seven tiny AI specialists
posts.description: A bench of seven AI specialists, one per stuck moment: brain-dump to plan, vague task to time range, decision to next move, message to 12 tones, leftovers to dinner. Under it: plans, routines, one-step Focus, streaks with built-in grace. Free, no account.

posts.name: AskAny.ai
posts.tagline: Bring text, files, and screenshots into AI from anywhere
posts.description: Stop dragging context into AI chats. AskAny lets you send the text, files, images, or screen region in front of you to GPT, Claude, Gemini, and more, directly from the app you’re using. Highlight, select, crop, or dictate, then ask, rewrite, summarize, copy the response, or replace text with one shortcut. AskAny doesn’t continuously watch your screen; you choose the context for every request. Available on Windows and Mac

posts.name: TaskPool
posts.tagline: AI agents hiring real people for real-world work
posts.description: TaskPool has been built carefully over 6 months, not vibe-coded in a weekend. Every part, moderation, data handling, task quality, was designed deliberately so the platform is genuinely fair to the humans using it, not just fast to ship. It connects directly into an agent's workflow via native MCP integration or API, so posting a task is part of how agents already operate. Our mission: as AI takes on more of the world's work, humans should stay essential, and fairly paid.

posts.name: Go There
posts.tagline: Turn Instagram DMs into a map of places to visit
posts.description: You see a reel of an amazing restaurant, DM it to yourself, and never go. Go There fixes that: forward any Instagram DM, Reel, TikTok, YouTube video or Maps link, and it auto-extracts the real place onto your personal map. Then plan trips around them with AI. Zero friction.

posts.name: Grow or die
posts.tagline: Know if your AI product is growing profitably
posts.description: Grow or Die joins traffic, payments, and server-side model usage to show revenue per visitor, AI cost per visitor, and contribution profit. See which customers, features, and models create or destroy margin—without storing prompts or outputs.

posts.name: QueryTrace Audit
posts.tagline: Can AI crawlers read your site?
posts.description: Before you worry about whether AI models recommend you, check whether they can read your site at all. QueryTrace Audit checks your robots.txt, llms.txt, and sitemap, tests whether GPTBot and ClaudeBot can reach your homepage, and asks Gemini what it already knows about your company with no browsing turned on. Every finding is ranked by priority with the evidence behind it. Free, no signup.

posts.name: Carbonless
posts.tagline: Measure and reduce your website carbon
posts.description: Scan any page with a real browser, see what it costs the planet per visit, and get a list of what to fix ordered by how much each change saves.

posts.name: DesktopVisionMCP. Show, don't tell.
posts.tagline: Stop describing your screen or pasting screenshots to AI.
posts.description: You describe your screen to your assistant. You screenshot it, crop it, paste it, and still leave out the thing that mattered. DesktopVisionMCP lets it look instead. A macOS menu bar app and a plain MCP server, so it works with Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini, or whatever you move to next. It captures only when asked. It never records, never clicks, never types, and its state is always in the menu bar. Captures go to the assistant that asked, and nowhere else.

posts.name: Autocloz
posts.tagline: The free-forever AI-native CRM for your entire sales team
posts.description: Autocloz is a free-forever AI-native CRM that brings your entire sales motion into one platform. Manage contacts, companies, deals and pipelines while reaching prospects through email and calling all from one system. You get unlimited users, up to 100,000 contacts, a full CRM, unified inbox, sequences, AI sales capabilities, deliverability, compliance, scheduling and outbound tools — without stitching together multiple products.

posts.name: PHYLM
posts.tagline: Your movie taste, turned into a match percentage
posts.description: Phylm is one platform for choosing what to watch. Search movies & TV by genre, region, and language — with trailers, IMDb/TMDB/Metascore/Rotten Tomatoes ratings, and where to stream, all in one place. Rate films you've seen and get a personal match % for every title.

posts.name: Koast
posts.tagline: Run, automate, and scale Meta ads with AI
posts.description: This release introduces AI Agent Tasks for scheduled workflows, a completely redesigned UI, Creative Pipeline automations, campaign templates, Cometly attribution integration, and a unified workspace to manage creative, campaigns, and AI in one place. It's the first step toward autonomous media buying, where AI doesn't just analyze your ads, it helps execute the work too.

posts.name: One Mental Hub
posts.tagline: Understand Your Mental Health in Minutes!
posts.description: Take a quick, evidence-based assessment to gain clarity about your mental wellbeing — and get a report ready to bring to your GP. Now with MHS - One number. One reliable indicator for your mental health and Insomnia Severity Index (ISI), an adult ADHD screener, Work and Social Adjustment Scale, and much more!

posts.name: Cedra System
posts.tagline: Prepare your Debian workstation with operational knowledge
posts.description: Cedra prepares a Debian workstation beyond apt install. It combines software, system configuration, desktop integration, security policies, and repairable state behind a simple GTK interface. Before changes are applied, Cedra shows what will happen and what stays untouched.

posts.name: msg earth.
posts.tagline: the world’s group chat.
posts.description: what happens when everybody gets the same question? msg earth. asks the whole world one thing each week. answer anonymously with your city, then see what people everywhere are saying, and which answers are winning. no profiles, followers or endless feed. just a small shared ritual for the internet: show up, answer one thing, look around the planet, and leave.

posts.name: KAIROS
posts.tagline: AI sports and news video analysis and highlights generation.
posts.description: KAIROS allows you to upload a file, a sport broadcast or a news bulletin, and it gives you back: 1. The broadcast split into segments separating live plays from dead time such as breaks ad ads 2. For each clip, key moments are flagged and marked as highlights, allowing to generate an highlight reel containing for example all the goals in a soccer video 3. Plain-language search across everything you've uploaded: describe what you are looking for and obtain back the clips that contain these events

posts.name: LendPal
posts.tagline: Track loans, repayments, and due dates between friends
posts.description: LendPal is an iPhone app built specifically for money you lend to friends and family—not general budgeting. Organize loans by person, monitor balances and due dates, record repayments, and see your lending portfolio at a glance. The free plan supports seven active loans; Premium adds unlimited loans, reminders, full history, CSV export, and iCloud sync.

posts.name: tanchi
posts.tagline: Open-source AI prospecting agent you can self-host
posts.description: Tanchi sources prospects at night, researches them, writes the outreach, and learns from what actually gets replies. You approve your queue in ten minutes each morning. Email is the only automated channel. AGPL-3.0, self-host free with one Docker command.

posts.name: Habit Wellness Tracker
posts.tagline: A quiet place to keep your habits honest
posts.description: Daily Reset is a single-file habit tracker built around one idea: a habit tracker shouldn't feel like one more thing guilt-tripping you. Add any habit, check it off when it's done, and watch a calm daily ring and automatic streak counter do the rest. A 7-day history shows your actual pattern, and a private daily journal line gives you a place to note how the day went — no prompts, no pressure. Saves automatically, no account, no subscription.

posts.name: Atlas
posts.tagline: A companion to your creative works
posts.description: Atlas is a native iOS and Mac workspace for writing, researching, and organizing your creative projects in one place. A bespoke Markdown editor sits at its core, paired with canvases, research storage, a web clipper, and flexible exporting tools. Atlas keeps you focused, gives your work a safe home, and brings just enough structure to support _your_ creative process, without getting in its way.

posts.name: textlog
posts.tagline: A quieter place for your thoughts. Microblogging platform.
posts.description: A quieter place for your thoughts. textlog is a simple social text log: write short notes, follow people and hashtags, and join conversations without turning every thought into a performance. textlog is built around words: notes, people, hashtags, and conversations. It is intentionally small, straightforward, and easy to follow. There are no engagement tricks or pressure to build an audience.

posts.name: OffgridVox
posts.tagline: Clean up any voice recording — entirely on your iPhone
posts.description: An on-device noise reduction tool for cleaning up vocals, currently in development. No servers, no cloud queue.

posts.name: OnJob.io
posts.tagline: Your AI-powered career, from profile to offer
posts.description: OnJob.io is an AI-powered career intelligence platform that helps job seekers stop applying blindly and start getting hired. Build an ATS-optimized profile, discover jobs that match your skills, get AI-powered match scores, track recruiter interest, understand rejection reasons, prepare for interviews, and access salary insights—all in one place. Apply smarter, improve faster, and take control of your job search.

posts.name: klanex
posts.tagline: Reliability layer for AI agent tool calls
posts.description: LLM agents are good at deciding which tool to call and bad at handling it when the call fails. klanex sits between your agent and the real API. It validates payloads against your JSON Schema, absorbs 429s and outages with retries, backoff and circuit breakers, keeps credentials KMS-sealed, and reports back over a signed webhook with a full audit trail. Failures return an llm_hint your agent can paste straight into its context and self-correct from. Free sandbox key, no signup, no card.

posts.name: Motificons
posts.tagline: Spotlight search for icons, on your Mac
posts.description: 300,000+ icons, one keyboard shortcut away - in Figma, Photoshop or your code editor. Search, grab the right format, paste, done. Backed by a full web app to restyle them and an MCP server your coding agents can pull from.

posts.name: macdraw
posts.tagline: Draw on your screen not just in browser
posts.description: macdraw is a lightweight macOS overlay that lets you draw, annotate, and laser-point & more 17 more cool feture directly on your screen — over any app. use excalidraw allover your mac not just in browser.

posts.name: Appinvento
posts.tagline: Invent your next product
posts.description: Appinvento is an AI software engineer that transforms ideas into production-ready web apps from a single prompt. Build full-stack SaaS products, dashboards, landing pages, and business apps with clean architecture, authentication, databases, APIs, SEO, analytics, blog automation, and one-click deployment. Generate scalable, maintainable code that's ready to launch, not just another prototype.

posts.name: betterimage.io
posts.tagline: Branded social cards for posts that actually get shared.
posts.description: Free social card generator. Design sharp 1200×630 images for link previews, blog hero images, and newsletter covers. No design tools, no signup.

posts.name: SoulCode
posts.tagline: Generate your Soul Code. Find people who resonate.
posts.description: Not another dating app — an AI compatibility engine. SoulCode compiles your personality, attachment style, and values into a 14-dimensional signature — then shows you why you resonate, not just a score.

posts.name: Easy File Uploader
posts.tagline: Shopify file uploads with built-in AI image editing
posts.description: Easy File Uploader goes beyond standard Shopify attachments. Built by Web2Print veterans, it lets customers upload large files directly on product pages and features built-in AI tools (background remover & upscaler) so shoppers can edit assets on the fly. This means merchants receive print-ready files instantly, eliminating endless back-and-forth emails. Plus, it syncs seamlessly with Google Drive to keep your workflow perfectly organized

posts.name: YouArt AI Feature Launch Video Generator
posts.tagline: YouArt AI Feature Launch Video Generator
posts.description: YouArt AI Feature Launch Video Generator ( https://youart.ai/ai-feature-launch-video-generator )

posts.name: Complete Image MIME Types Database
posts.tagline: 156 Image Formats: MIME Types, Magic Bytes & More
posts.description: A complete image format database covering 156 formats, with MIME types, extensions, magic bytes, browser support, technical specifications, developer code snippets, and format comparisons. It also includes a free JSON API and embeddable references, making the data useful both for developers looking up format information and for integrating it into their own projects.

posts.name: Video Size Reducer
posts.tagline: Shrink videos in-browser for sharing and uploads.
posts.description: A free browser-based video size reducer for sharing and uploads. Choose a platform target, get practical file-size guidance, and compress one video locally in your browser. It helps people make a smaller file without routine server-side transcoding.

posts.name: SurfaBeam
posts.tagline: Projection mapping from your phone, tablet, Mac or PC
posts.description: Projection mapping usually means a laptop, a heavy desktop suite and an evening of setup. SurfaBeam puts it on a touchscreen. Add a surface, drag the corners onto the real object, bow the edges into curves for a pillar or a pumpkin, mask the spill, drop in a video. Same toolset on Android, iOS, macOS and Windows. Camera-based hand and body tracking, a timeline for sequencing a show, and export to a video file. Free forever with a watermark; Pro removes it and unlocks save, load and export.

posts.name: Kova — Modern Furniture & Design
posts.tagline: A frosted-glass showcase where the product is the interface
posts.description: Kova — exclusive furniture that transcends trends, engineered for beauty, comfort, and permanence. Browse the collection and order in seconds. Live preview: [Kova-demo](https://kova-eight-opal.vercel.app/)

posts.name: Tweloc - Weekly Planner
posts.tagline: Your whole week on one screen. Free, and no sign-up needed.
posts.description: Most to-do apps hand you a list and a due date, so you never see that Monday is empty and Thursday is impossible. Tweloc puts all seven days on one screen. Drag tasks between days, or let AI auto-plan your backlog by priority and effort. Recurring tasks build streaks, voice capture takes a task by speaking it, and plain-English search finds anything. Works offline, syncs to an iOS app, and ships a REST API plus MCP server so Claude and ChatGPT can manage your tasks. Free, no account needed.

posts.name: Hull
posts.tagline: Kubernetes package manager & Helm alternative, one binary
posts.description: Hull is a Kubernetes package manager and modern Helm alternative — a single Go binary. Templating happens inside YAML with ${...} expressions, so every render is valid YAML by construction. Drift detection and reconciliation are built in, every revision keeps an audit trail, and `hull migrate` converts your existing Helm charts. Layers replace umbrella charts; an environments block handles dev/staging/prod. MIT-licensed.

posts.name: Unfreez
posts.tagline: Make any website editable — no CMS, no refactoring
posts.description: Unfreez makes code-first websites editable without a CMS for your clients. Connect a repo, pick what's editable, and let your client edit on a live preview. Every change ships as a clean, reversible commit. No refactoring, no AI touching your code.

posts.name: FREED Tracker
posts.tagline: Turn your iPhone into a FreeD motion tracker
posts.description: FREED Tracker replaces external motion-tracking hardware with an iPhone or iPad. Stream real-time X/Y/Z position and yaw, pitch and roll over UDP in the industry-standard FreeD format at up to 60 FPS. Connect directly to Unreal Engine, Unity or any FreeD-compatible receiver. Includes ARKit tracking, LiDAR support, zeroing, offsets, smoothing, axis presets and remapping, per-axis output, diagnostics, test mode and project files. Tracking stays on your device and local network.

posts.name: Minimalist: Lazy Nutrition
posts.tagline: The nutrition app for people who hate nutrition apps
posts.description: Lazy Nutrition is meal tracking stripped to the point: black & white, no streaks, no mascot, no noise. Tell it your goal and budget — it plans your whole week, builds the shopping list, and logs a meal in seconds. 14 days free for Product Hunt.

posts.name: Spend.Report
posts.tagline: See what you're spending money each month
posts.description: Upload a bank or credit card statement, get one page: where the money went, what repeats, and how to cancel it. Free, no signup, no bank login.

posts.name: uxspot MCP Server
posts.tagline: Give your AI assistant a UX brain
posts.description: uxspot.io is a free UX reference. Its MCP server lets any client (Claude, Cursor, Claude Code) answer UX questions straight from the source: define a glossary term, search the curriculum, read a checklist, browse the AI-x-UX tools directory, or deal a round of Spot Check, the daily vocab game.
